title: View
description: Workspace closure per spec.md §5.6 + ADR-0025. Effect Buffer = Block (effects_hash is content-addressed).

namespace.description: Map<Name, Hash> visible from inside the View.

effects_hash.description: Hash of the pending-effects Block (Class B + C effects), or null. THIS is reel's distinctive structural commitment — pending effects are content-addressed.

status.description: View lifecycle state. `active` is the only non-terminal state (per spec.md §5.6.1).

parent.description: Parent ViewId. null for root View.

x-reel-status: v0.1 canonical (per ADR-0025). Replaces pre-ADR-0024 schema that used boolean `aborted` + buffer counts.
